shots.name: 01-pad
shots.before: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const p = Store.projects().find(x => x.title === 'Kitchen Window'); App.setView('pad'); await sleep(200); await Engine.play(p, p.openScene); await sleep(1500); })()

shots.name: 02-recording
shots.before: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); Store.set('countIn', 4); document.getElementById('pad').click(); await sleep(4200); })()

shots.name: 03-layer
shots.before: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); App.back(); await sleep(400); const sc = Store.current(App.project()); App.openLayerSheet(sc.layers[0].id); await sleep(400); })()

shots.name: 04-arrange
shots.before: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); App.back(); await sleep(250); App.setView('arrange'); await sleep(500); document.querySelector('#v-arrange .scroller').scrollTop = 0; })()

shots.name: 05-library
shots.before: (async () => { const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); App.setView('library'); await sleep(500); document.querySelector('#v-library .scroller').scrollTop = 0; })()
